voices.name: l00
voices.text: Their words are sweet, <#0.2#> but somehow you always feel drained after seeing them?
voices.caption: Their words are sweet, but somehow you always feel drained after seeing them?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: That uneasy feeling <#0.3#> isn't just in your head.
voices.caption: That uneasy feeling isn't just in your head.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: It's a clear signal <#0.2#> from your soul.
voices.caption: It's a clear signal from your soul.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: People who truly know themselves <#0.2#> never ignore that signal.
voices.caption: People who truly know themselves never ignore that signal.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: They close the door on people who treat them carelessly, <#0.2#> and open their hearts only to those who respect them.
voices.caption: They close the door on people who treat them carelessly, and open their hearts only to those who respect them.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: That's the boundary <#0.2#> people who love themselves draw.
voices.caption: That's the boundary people who love themselves draw.
